correctness.rationale: For component curvatures A=m(1±delta), B=m(1±delta), uniform marginals force P(--)=P(++)=(1−q)/2 and P(+-)=P(-+)=q/2. Scalar Heun multiplier 1−h(A+B)/2+h²AB/2 yields exactly M_q=R_cross²+(1−q)t²delta²[2(t−1)²+1]. Excess strictly positive for all t>0,delta>0; independence in time gives E X_k²=M_q^k X0². R_cross zero iff 1−delta² times t²−2t+2=0, discriminant 4(2delta²−1); positive roots exactly delta>=1/sqrt2. Fraction/symbolic independent algebra and rational witness checked. Does not claim any finite-step result for nonlinear or high-dimensional models.
